svg-basic.title: SVG figure
svg-basic.summary: Host-rendered SVG with notes, subjects, connectors, and layout diagnostics.
svg-basic.try: Open the figure, inspect its callouts, then change one note or anchor in main.ts. Compare the resulting geometry.
svg-basic.boundary: The fixture draws the underlying figure. The package resolves and renders only the annotations.

react-basic.title: React annotation layer
react-basic.summary: A React-rendered workflow with a separate annotation SVG layer.
react-basic.try: Inspect the workflow and notes together, then change a note in main.tsx and observe the rendered update.
react-basic.boundary: React state, the underlying workflow SVG, and overlay mounting belong to this host.

react-incremental.title: Interactive annotation editor
react-incremental.summary: Drag and edit notes, inspect JSON, and undo committed changes with host-owned history.
react-incremental.try: Drag a note handle, use Move final anchor, edit a note title and apply it, then Undo and Redo. Copy the current JSON and load it back. Invalid JSON must leave the current state untouched.
react-incremental.boundary: History, selection, forms, JSON validation, and persistence decisions are application code. The small importer accepts point/box annotations and at most ten notes; it is not a general package serializer.

react-worker.title: Worker layout experiment
react-worker.summary: Host-owned module Worker with revision-safe results and responsive UI controls.
react-worker.try: Move the final anchor or host obstacle, supersede a request, and start a cancellable job. Use Ignore pending result and the UI response control to observe the distinction between result admission and background solver work.
react-worker.boundary: The host creates the Worker, tracks revisions, and decides which result to accept. Ignoring a result does not interrupt solver CPU work. This is an experimental recipe, not a public Worker API.

react-flow-basic.title: React Flow diagram
react-flow-basic.summary: Callouts attached to public node, handle, edge, and viewport geometry.
react-flow-basic.try: Inspect the generated graph and annotated targets. Change a node or viewport input in main.tsx and compare target alignment.
react-flow-basic.boundary: React Flow owns graph rendering and state. The annotations adapter consumes its public geometry instead of owning graph layout.

dom-basic.title: DOM regions
dom-basic.summary: Annotations attached to measured regions of an ordinary HTML surface.
dom-basic.try: Inspect the two host regions and their notes. Change a region size or position and observe the measured overlay.
dom-basic.boundary: The host owns DOM content, measurement timing, and mounting. All measured rectangles must be converted into the overlay coordinate space.

vega-basic.title: Vega and Vega-Lite
vega-basic.summary: Notes attached to rendered chart marks and geometry supplied by Vega.
vega-basic.try: Inspect the real chart marks and callouts, then change a target specification in main.ts. Check adapter diagnostics rather than assuming a mark matched.
vega-basic.boundary: Vega renders the chart. The adapter uses its produced geometry; the annotations core does not manage scales or chart data.

mermaid-basic.title: Mermaid diagrams
mermaid-basic.summary: Annotations on actual rendered Mermaid diagram geometry.
mermaid-basic.try: Inspect the rendered diagram targets and notes. Change a label or target specification, then check missing-target diagnostics.
mermaid-basic.boundary: Mermaid parses and lays out the diagram. The adapter runs after rendering and uses SVG geometry, not a second diagram parser.

d2-basic.title: D2 diagram
d2-basic.summary: Callouts on D2 compiled or rendered shape and connection geometry.
d2-basic.try: Inspect the rendered D2 shapes and annotation targets. Change a target specification and compare the validation report.
d2-basic.boundary: D2 compiles and renders the diagram. The adapter consumes shape/route geometry without taking over D2 layout.

bronto-report.title: Annotated report
bronto-report.summary: Annotations over report geometry with an optional Bronto styling bridge.
bronto-report.try: Inspect note placement over the report and compare the migrated static annotation with the resolved layer.
bronto-report.boundary: The report content and layout belong to the host. Bronto-compatible CSS is optional; the engine does not require a design system.

style-gallery.title: Annotation styles
style-gallery.summary: A visual reference for callout variants and the optional annotation CSS.
style-gallery.try: Inspect the visual variants, then change a style token or annotation option and compare the result.
style-gallery.boundary: This is a styling fixture, not an application editor or a chart engine.

index.title: Visual example index
index.summary: An annotated overview with links to the individual demonstration surfaces.
index.try: Use the published index to navigate between examples. For local cross-example navigation, build and serve the full site as described in the catalog.
index.boundary: The index illustrates the annotation grammar. Each linked page is a separate host fixture.
